Wins

Configuration · defined at config.mbt:90

pub(all) enum Wins {
  Base
  Extra
}

Which of the two ways of giving a configuration wins when both are given.

Extra — the flat arguments — is the default, because a caller who took the trouble to write track_ref=true on one call means it on that call.

Variants

VariantMeaning
Base

The record wins: the flat arguments are ignored where they clash.

Extra

The flat arguments win. The default.
